subject: Using R (or ArcMap) to split transects into equal length segments

messages.author: 2481dd60d74e4239
messages.subject: Using R (or ArcMap) to split transects into equal length segments
parts:
Hello!

I'm attempting to perform a DSM analysis on a fairly unorthodox data set and have become involved in a lot of post-processing of spatial data to get our transects into the proper format. I'm working on splitting up transects into equal length segments and have had much difficulty finding a method to perform this in bulk (for many transects) using spatial tools in R (or ArcMap). I currently have the transect data in SpatialLinesDataFrame and/or shapefile format. If anyone has any experience with this issue and can direct to a package that would be helpful in segmenting these transects, I would appreciate it greatly.

Thanks a lot,
Sara Williams

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Using R (or ArcMap) to split transects into equal length segments
parts:
Hi Sara, hi listfolk,

I think you might find the Marine Geospatial Ecology Tools for ArcGIS
quite handy for these tasks: http://mgel.env.duke.edu/mget/

Hope this helps!

cheers,
--dave
